description: Manage OMAPI hosts into compatible DHCPd servers.

parameters.name: ddns
parameters.description: Enable dynamic DNS updates for this host. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Sets OMAPI server host to interact with. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Sets the host lease hostname (mandatory if state=present).

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: Sets the lease host IP address.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Sets the TSIG key content for authenticating against OMAPI server.

parameters.name: key_name
parameters.description: Sets the TSIG key name for authenticating against OMAPI server.

parameters.name: macaddr
parameters.description: Sets the lease host MAC address.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Sets the OMAPI server port to interact with. Default: 7911

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or remove OMAPI host. Choices: "absent" "present"

parameters.name: statements
parameters.description: Attach a list of OMAPI DHCP statements with host lease (without ending semicolon). Default: []

examples:
- name: Add a host using OMAPI
  community.general.omapi_host:
    key_name: defomapi
    key: +bFQtBCta6j2vWkjPkNFtgA==
    host: 10.98.4.55
    macaddr: 44:dd:ab:dd:11:44
    name: server01
    ip: 192.168.88.99
    ddns: true
    statements:
      - filename "pxelinux.0"
      - next-server 1.1.1.1
    state: present

- name: Remove a host using OMAPI
  community.general.omapi_host:
    key_name: defomapi
    key: +bFQtBCta6j2vWkjPkNFtgA==
    host: 10.1.1.1
    macaddr: 00:66:ab:dd:11:44
    state: absent

return_values.name: lease
return_values.description: Dictionary containing host information. Returned: success

return_values.name: hardware-type
return_values.description: Hardware type, generally 1. Returned: success Sample: 1

return_values.name: ip-address
return_values.description: IP address, if there is. Returned: success Sample: "192.168.1.5"
